system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

Emplacement Points: 3

A Shieldbuster Torpedo Launcher carries a Starship's Shieldbuster Torpedo payload. A standard Shieldbuster Torpedo Launcher holds four Shieldbuster Torpedoes (See below). Additional capacity may be added, increasing the cost by 25% for each additional Shieldbuster Torpedo (Up to a maximum of eight Shieldbuster Torpedoes).

Shieldbuster Torpedoes

Emplacement Points: 0

Proton Torpedo Ranges
RANGE BY CHARACTER SCALE

RANGE BY STARSHIP SCALE

0-450 Squares 451-900 Squares 901-2,250 Squares 2,251-4,000 Squares 0-3 Squares 4-6 Squares 7-15 Squares 16-30 Squares

These are plasma-based torpedo weapons that create bursts of Radiation specifically designed to overwhelm Starship Shields. The T-33 used by BTL-56 K-Wings is typical of weapons of this type. Against anything but a Shield Rating, Shieldbuster Torpedoes deal half damage. If an attack from a Shieldbuster Torpedo exceeds a target's Shield Rating, the target loses 10 points from it's Shield Rating (Rather than the normal 5). Shields damaged in this way can be recharged normally.
